domain: Compact Omega subset R^d, mu,nu in P(Omega), x in Omega
quantifier: Every fixed context for the query bound and every pair of context measures for fixed query
predicate: Gamma(mu,.) is 1-Lipschitz and Gamma(.,x) has a finite W1 Lipschitz constant
failure_condition: A valid query pair exceeds ratio one or no finite KR quotient bound exists
